note: msa-shared-lib order-service: RestTemplateBuilder moved to org.springframework.boot.restclient (spring-boot-restclient) in Boot 4 — L2 `compile|package_does_not_exist|org.springframework.boot.web.client` (15b2b07ac0)
response:
<analysis>Spring Boot 4 split the HTTP clients out of spring-boot: RestTemplateBuilder is org.springframework.boot.restclient.RestTemplateBuilder in spring-boot-restclient, which the service does not declare. The script moves the import and adds spring-boot-starter-restclient (managed by the parent) to the module pom when it is missing.</analysis>
<script>
OLD = "import org.springframework.boot.web.client.RestTemplateBuilder;"
NEW = "import org.springframework.boot.restclient.RestTemplateBuilder;"

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen

def module_pom(p, path):
    """The pom.xml of the module that holds `path` (nearest folder upwards with a pom.xml)."""
    parts = path.split("/")[:-1]
    while parts:
        candidate = "/".join(parts + ["pom.xml"])
        if p.exists(candidate):
            return candidate
        parts.pop()
    return "pom.xml"


def fix(p):
    poms = []
    for path in error_files(p):
        if p.replace(path, OLD, NEW):
            p.log(f"{path}: RestTemplateBuilder import -> org.springframework.boot.restclient")
        pom = module_pom(p, path)
        if pom not in poms:
            poms.append(pom)
    for path in poms:
        pom = p.pom(path)
        if pom.has_dependency("org.springframework.boot", "spring-boot-starter-restclient"):
            p.log(f"{path}: spring-boot-starter-restclient already declared")
            continue
        pom.add_dependency("org.springframework.boot", "spring-boot-starter-restclient")
        pom.save()
        p.log(f"{path}: + org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-restclient")
</script>
